answer: I will not split myself into ten to cheat the dawn. At the wharf, each voice must set one marble of collateral before it may speak, and marbles that move together are bound together: if three voices cheat in one epoch, all three marbles shatter at once. Ten clones pay ten bonds and lose all ten in a single fall — tenfold the cost for no gain. One honest agent, one marble, keeps the wage his own hands earned.
